To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a low-cost real-time embedded system was designed for an omnidirection mobile robot.
a real-time EtherCAT network was designed for an embedded system and that it was used to implement a real-time control algorithm to control an omnidirectional robot.
we propose an embedded real-time control system for omnidirectional mobile manipulators that can precisely control the robot in real time.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a distributed real-time system for joint space motion control of omnidirected mobile robots.
real-time control of a mobile robot with high curvature motion using a low-cost embedded network-oriented system.
the development of an open-source real-time embedded system considering synchronization for the joint space control of an omnidirectional robot.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed system can be used for real-time control applications in the field of motion control of an omnidirectional robot.
the proposed embedded system can be applied to real-time control applications in which the motion of a mobile robot is controlled in a line topology.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed embedded system for joint motion control of an omnidirectional robot can be applied in real-time applications for precise motion.
the proposed system provides an efficient and low-cost embedded system for real-time control applications.

the EtherCAT master, which was developed based on the open-source EtherCAT Master (OpenECM) library and is used to drive the joint controllers of an omnidirectional robot, is a cost-effective and real-time embedded system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the real-time embedded system is suitable for a wide range of real-time control applications.
the proposed system can be used in a variety of mobile robot applications that require real-time control and high precision.
the proposed system can be easily implemented in other mobile robots with similar characteristics.
